caption: The drawing features a central tree with curved, palm-like fronds and flowing, arching branches. The tree has a thick trunk, colored in shades of muted pink and purple, extending outwards with leaves that are similarly shaded in light pinks, purples, and occasional hints of maroon. Perched in various sections of the tree and its branches are small animals, including two monkeys near the top left and a bird on a lower branch. There are also two birds depicted, one standing on the ground near the right side and another amidst the foliage at the bottom. On the left side near the base of the tree, there is a human figure wearing a costume resembling leaves or feathers, holding a large leaf in their raised right hand. The background is filled with fine stippling in pink, and light vines with leaves and berries extend across the surface, giving a sense of lively plant growth. The colors of the entire composition are primarily muted pinks, purples, and maroons on a pale, beige background, and the drawing is framed by a simple light-colored border.
title: Block Print
